t: You're at Warren Street tube station, where Tottenham Court Road meets Euston Road at the northern edge of Fitzrovia. The Northern and Victoria lines meet here, and there's an exit for University College Hospital. It's in zone 1 and is used less than many of its neighbours. The architect Charles Holden designed it. He's best known for designing many Underground stations in the 1920s and 1930s, as well as 55 Broadway, Senate House and Bristol Central Library.
